assumptions: Universal interacting higher-rank infinite-class robustness remains OPEN outside the constructed subcases. The backbone theorem requires every immigration/degradation pair already present; it cannot create a missing species, reaction vector or state edge. Tail-star flux lumping DOES inherit full nominal forms/weighted variance exactly; simple cycle deletion still need not. The activity-weighted inequality is stronger than ordinary physical gap/nominal LSI and is not proved for every allowed design; the original uniform menu fails it on the trap. It is sufficient, not necessary, and its failure is not failure of the already robust-positive physical network. ROOT two-cut analysis proves zero embedded gap for h=0 andh>=2 in its restricted pair-degreeK/B-degreeK+h family; h=1 clears only those TWO cuts, not allcuts/fullgap or independent-error stability. Gauge stress tests require GLOBAL complex balance; numerical polynomial tolerance remains possible. Finite entropy dissipation overlaps ROOT4326 and receives only an evidence update. Previously required perturbed moments remain premises of the older moment-transfer route; they are not an extra premise of the new activity-weighted sufficient theorem. No deterministic permanence announcement, ConStRAINeD in-preparation manuscript or unresolved citation identifier supplies a quantitative stochastic theorem. Source/model/transfer/ZIP/Sol/Dots/native-retrieval/resource holds persist; no new Capital scientific execution, novelty or physical advantage claim.
